title: Spin and find the target
situation: A full turn on the spot in two half turns while Shim walks round her. When the spin ends her eyes find him first, then the head, then the feet step round to face him. The feet and the hips turn together; nothing teleports.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
